_comment: Pelican/Pterodactyl-compatible egg for SSJ MUSIC ROBOT
name: SSJ MUSIC ROBOT
author: saintsanji@proton.me
description: Discord music bot using discord.js, Node.js 22, and NodeLink.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

apt-get update
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates git python3 make g++

: "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY:?GITHUB_REPOSITORY is required}"
: "${GITHUB_REF:?GITHUB_REF is required}"

find /mnt/server -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -exec rm -rf -- {} +
git clone --depth 1 --branch "${GITHUB_REF}" "https://github.com/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}.git" /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server
npm ci --include=dev
npm run build

nodeLinkHost="${NODELINK_HOST,,}"
case "$nodeLinkHost" in
  localhost|127.0.0.1|::1)
    : "${NODELINK_SOURCE_REPOSITORY:=PerformanC/NodeLink}"
    : "${NODELINK_SOURCE_REF:=main}"
    git clone --depth 1 --branch "$NODELINK_SOURCE_REF" "https://github.com/${NODELINK_SOURCE_REPOSITORY}.git" /mnt/server/nodelink
    cd /mnt/server/nodelink
    npm ci --include=dev
    ;;
  *)
    echo "External NodeLink selected at $NODELINK_HOST; skipping embedded NodeLink install."
    ;;
esac

echo 'SSJ MUSIC ROBOT installed successfully.'

variables.name: Discord Bot Token
variables.description: Bot token from the Discord Developer Portal. Treat this value as a secret.

variables.name: Discord Application ID
variables.description: Application ID used by the optional slash-command deployment script.

variables.name: Discord Guild ID
variables.description: Optional guild ID for instant guild-scoped slash-command deployment. Leave blank to deploy globally.

variables.name: NodeLink Host
variables.description: Hostname or IP address of the NodeLink server reachable from this game server. Do not use 127.0.0.1 unless NodeLink shares this server's network namespace.

variables.name: NodeLink Password
variables.description: The password configured in NodeLink. Treat this value as a secret.

variables.name: NodeLink Secure Connection
variables.description: Set true when NodeLink uses TLS/WSS; otherwise false.

variables.name: GitHub Repository
variables.description: Public GitHub repository in owner/repository format; change this when using a fork.

variables.name: Git Ref
variables.description: Branch or tag to install. Defaults to v0.2.0 for a reproducible release install.

variables.name: Embedded NodeLink Repository
variables.description: NodeLink repository to clone when NODELINK_HOST is localhost or loopback.

variables.name: Embedded NodeLink Ref
variables.description: Branch or tag to install for embedded NodeLink.
